source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-40

procedures.title: Sight glass: replace
steps: Unscrew the sight glass retainer nut with a screwdriver and take out the old glass and seal.
Fit the new glass, seal and retainer nut; do not turn the nut beyond the face of the housing or the O-ring seal may be damaged.

procedures.title: Compressor: description
notes: All systems use the same basic six-cylinder reciprocating compressor in two sizes: 12.6 cu. in. for Four-Season (except Corvette) and Comfortron, and 10.8 cu. in. for the Corvette Four-Season system and GM Chevrolet Air Conditioning.

procedures.title: Compressor: remove and install
steps: Remove: purge the refrigerant from the system.
Take out the connector attaching bolt and the connector, and seal the connector outlets.
Unplug the lead to the clutch coil.
Loosen the brace and pivot bolts and take the belt off.
Remove the nuts and bolts holding the compressor brackets to the mounting bracket (see figures 47 and 48 in the manual; figure 48 has a Corvette view).
Before any compressor teardown, drain and measure its oil and check it for contamination to judge whether the rest of the system needs service.

Install: if the drained oil was clean, put the same amount of fresh refrigeration oil into the compressor; if the whole system had to be serviced for heavy contamination, put in a full fresh oil charge (see Checking Compressor Oil Charge).
notes: Compressor overhaul is covered in the Chassis Overhaul Manual.
